render.caption: 1200 × 834 native renders; same Overview camera and settings. Drag to compare the cart in the foreground. Only metadata was removed from the published images.

steps.title: Reject the stale version
steps.detail: The submitted source hash did not match the bytes copied from the scene. Blender was never launched for this attempt. The engine still recorded the failed action.

steps.title: Edit from the preserved snapshot
steps.detail: The expected, source and snapshot hashes matched. The trusted script moved 28 cart components by 25 cm along X and saved a separate editable scene.

steps.title: Reopen and measure again
steps.detail: Fresh Blender processes loaded the edited file, rechecked cart positions and rendered it. The original source and snapshots stayed unchanged; the scene retained 1,571 meshes.

steps.title: Check the actual target
steps.detail: The first Unreal build failed in NullRHI viewport handling. After confirming that process had exited, an explicit GPU-mode build used a new destination. A separate editor process reopened the saved level.

checks: Stale source rejected before Blender launch
Copied bytes match the reviewed hash
Cart X movement measured; Y/Z unchanged

unreal.summary: Unreal 5.7.4 reopened the revised laboratory in a fresh GPU-enabled editor process. This run checked static structure and placement; it did not capture an Unreal render.
checks: 1,571 mesh actors, 82 reusable mesh assets and 17 materials.
Instance transforms, material properties and mesh bounds matched the exported manifest.
Both the successful build and fresh inspection exited with code 0.

limitations: The initial NullRHI environment build crashed in viewport actor placement. Its failure and the explicit GPU retry are retained in the raw evidence.
GPU mode was used for structure checks. Unreal appearance, navigation, robot control and packaged gameplay were not validated in this run.
Blender checks cover cart positions, mesh count and native reopen invariants, not every unrelated transform or mesh byte.
Only .blend bytes are pinned. The resource gate covers known built-in types, not every add-on, script or external dependency.
Trusted Python remains privileged. Read-only snapshots are not an OS sandbox or a rollback mechanism.
Downloads contain publication copies re-saved to remove local metadata. Their hashes are distinct from the unchanged execution source where applicable.
provenance: Observed 2026-10-24. Original public laboratory, real Blender and Unreal adapters, no synthetic host substitution. Native files and image hashes are included in the downloadable evidence.
